extension.summary: Add-ons distributed through the Nostr network
extension.description: A decentralized Kodi repository: the add-on catalog is published on Nostr relays (NIP-34, kinds 30617/30618) and the files are downloaded from Blossom servers, verified by SHA-256. No central server needed - repositories are published with ngit (npm install -g nostr-git).
extension.news: v1.1.0 - package request waits up to 15s for the on-demand build (first click usually succeeds without prebuild) v1.0.10 - parallel blob downloads (8 workers), prebuilds packages concurrently, no duplicate background builders v1.0.9 - faster Blossom attempts, per-file download diagnostics, non-blocking package requests, negative DNS cache v1.0.8 - alternative DNS resolver, HEAD support, persistent cache, background pre-build v1.0.7 - previous release
